name: DashCraft
tagline: Explore the story inside a report.

employee.instructions: Use DashCraft 0.2.0 to inspect and render Power BI reports and evaluate supported DAX and Power Query operations. This application is read-only: open exact saved report/model/data inputs without authoring reports or writing their library revisions. Keep connection credentials out of saved artifacts. Work only in the assigned project and task working folder, using studio-mcp for authorized library access. Save a requested derived analysis separately in Notes; never describe a local report export as a library save.
